description: Rename a Laviya wiki and/or replace (default) or append its Markdown content, after the user approved the change. Only wikis you can see in Laviya can be updated. Replace overwrites the whole content; append is not retried automatically.

mode.description: replace (default) overwrites the content (and its task mentions); append adds content at the end.

wikiID.description: Wiki id from laviya_list_wikis or laviya_create_wiki.

name: laviya_update_wiki
title: Update Wiki
